suggestions.body: Set the tempo to 128.0 (half/double: 64/256). Turn on Scale in the Control Bar with root C and scale Major so MIDI devices and the piano roll follow it. Camelot 8B if you are mixing it. If you drop the audio in, warp it in Beats mode.
suggestions.title: Set the project to 128 BPM, C Major

suggestions.body: Measured per section, since drums change between sections. Averaged over the busiest bars the whole track reads as kick on steps 1, 9; snare on steps 1, 3, 5, 7, 9, 11, 15; hat on steps 1, 3, 5, 7, 9, 11, 13, 15; tom on steps 15; cymbal on steps 1. Program it on a Drum Rack (kick C1, snare D1, hat F#1, tom A1, cymbal C#2) and vary the last bar of every 4.

suggestions.title: Pattern idea: Rolling 16ths

suggestions.body: Per-bar bass notes loop as A - F - C - G (scale degrees 6 - 4 - 1 - 5). It moves in fourths and fifths, classic root motion. Keep the bass on chord roots and add an octave jump on the last 16th of the bar.
suggestions.title: Bass loop: A - F - C - G (fourths/fifths)

suggestions.body: Put a Compressor on the bass, enable Sidechain from the kick, ratio 4:1, attack 0.1 ms, release about 141-234 ms (an 8th note at this tempo is 234 ms). Or use Live 12's Shaper/Envelope Follower for a drawn ducking curve.
suggestions.title: Sidechain the bass to the kick

suggestions.body: The most common 4-bar loop reads as Am - F - C - G (vi - IV - I - V in C Major). Sketch it with the Chord MIDI effect or Live 12's chord generators, then thin the voicing so it doesn't fight the bass.
suggestions.title: Chord loop guess: Am - F - C - G

suggestions.body: Am shows up in 8 bars. For leads or arps over it, A Minor fits.
suggestions.title: Over Am (vi): play A Minor

suggestions.body: F shows up in 8 bars. For leads or arps over it, F Lydian fits.
suggestions.title: Over F (IV): play F Lydian

suggestions.body: C shows up in 8 bars. For leads or arps over it, C Major fits.
suggestions.title: Over C (I): play C Major

suggestions.body: G shows up in 4 bars. For leads or arps over it, G Mixolydian fits.
suggestions.title: Over G (V): play G Mixolydian

suggestions.body: For hooks that never clash, set Scale to C Major Pentatonic and run an Arpeggiator (Up/Down, 1/16) into a short pluck.
suggestions.title: Safe lead scale: C Major Pentatonic

suggestions.body: Rough layout: Intro A (bars 1-8), Drop B (bars 9-24), Outro A (bars 25-33). Drop locators at those bars in Arrangement View to rebuild the structure, then fill in your own parts.
suggestions.title: Arrangement map: 3 sections

suggestions.body: Most energy sits low-mid. Roll off highs on pads (EQ Eight shelf around 6 kHz) and let only hats and one lead live up top.
